title: First Boot Checklist
summary: Verify power, storage, and baseline services before running models.

sections.heading: Core Checks
steps: Confirm the USB drive is mounted and writable.
Open the local UI at http://127.0.0.1:7777.
Run System Calibration once to validate CPU and RAM detection.
Confirm at least one model shows as available in the Library.

sections.heading: If Something Fails
steps: Restart the launcher for your OS and wait 20 seconds.
Check the Diagnostics panel for missing paths.
Verify the models folder contains .gguf files.

title: Model Recovery (No Internet)
summary: Bring models back online using only local assets.

sections.heading: Quick Fix
steps: Open Library and click Rescan to rebuild the index.
If a model is missing, confirm the file name matches manifest.json.
Reload the model from the Model Manager card.

sections.heading: Deep Repair
steps: Check the models directory for partial downloads or split files.
Keep only the newest copy of the model.
Restart the server to reset the index cache.

title: Offline Safety Protocol
summary: Operate in isolation while keeping outputs controlled.

sections.heading: Operator Rules
steps: Review the prompt before sending sensitive requests.
Keep uncensored mode off unless you have explicit approval.
Use short prompts when system resources are limited.

sections.heading: Output Handling
steps: Store outputs locally in the data folder.
Do not copy results to networked systems while offline.
Purge temporary files when the task is complete.

title: Storage Hygiene
summary: Keep disk usage predictable and models healthy.

sections.heading: Weekly
steps: Remove unused model copies from the models folder.
Archive old chats if data is growing quickly.
Verify the runtime folder has enough free space.

sections.heading: Monthly
steps: Check logs for repeated startup failures.
Back up data and models to an offline drive.
Validate the manifest list matches your stored models.

title: Field Prompting Quickstart
summary: Get reliable answers fast when connectivity is limited.

sections.heading: Structure
steps: State the objective in one sentence.
List constraints like time, resources, or tools.
Request the response format you need.

sections.heading: Example
steps: Objective: Build a battery check procedure.
Constraints: 10 minutes, no internet.
Format: numbered checklist.

title: Emergency Shutdown
summary: Safely stop models and services during incidents.

sections.heading: Order of Operations
steps: Unload the active model in Library.
Close the UI tab.
Stop the launcher or close the terminal window.

sections.heading: If the UI is Unresponsive
steps: Use the OS task manager to stop the server process.
Reboot the device if the model process will not exit.
Review diagnostics after restart.
